Basis for Intervening:
The NIPSCO Large Customer Group (“NLCG”) is a group of large volume industrial users with facilities located within the electric service territory of Northern Indiana Public Service Company (“NIPSCO”).  NIPSCO is a transmission owner within the Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. (“MISO”).  Members of the NLCG purchase retail electric service from NIPSCO directly, and some members purchase electricity from MISO through NIPSCO pursuant to a retail tariff.  As large energy consumers of electricity from NIPSCO and MISO with potential to expand facilities or otherwise incrementally increase their load, the NLCG members have a substantial interest in the subject matter of this proceeding.  

Because of those interests, members of the NLCG seek to intervene to protect them, and the interest of members of the NLCG are not and will not be adequately represented by existing parties in this proceeding.  Their participation in this proceeding, therefore, would be in the public interest.  Therefore, the NLCG respectfully requests that the Commission grant this motion to intervene and grant the NLCG status as a full party to this proceeding.
